title: Rank criterion for the coarea Jacobian (J*f(x) = 0 iff rank df_x < m)
statement: For all N, m ∈ ℕ, every set M ⊆ ℝᴺ, every map f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ and every point x ∈ ℝᴺ (ℝᵖ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)): with T := tangentSpace M x and L_x := Df(x) ∘ ι_T : T → ℝᵐ (Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, ι_T the inclusion), coareaJacobian M f x = √det(L_x L_x*) equals 0 if and only if the dimension of range(L_x) = LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (tangentSpace M x).subtype) is < m. No hypothesis on M or f is needed.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N), coareaJacobian M f x = 0 ↔ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (tangentSpace M x).subtype)) < m
